frames.alt: a featureless gold metallic mannequin figure
frames.caption: A featureless gold metallic mannequin figure. Standing upright facing forward with arms outstretched to either side and palms facing up. A small enclosed room covered entirely in white square ceramic tiles on the floor and walls. White overhead light originating from a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling. Gold metal, white ceramic tile, grey iron, and glass.
frames.anomaly: A large circular iron storm-drain grate embedded in the center of the tiled room floor.
